Collect.description: Capture without filtering; empty the inbox later.

content.text: Capture every commitment, idea or interruption in one line, verbatim. Do not classify, prioritize or drop anything. Use capture. Return when the inbox holds what the user said.
Pick one actionable work item. Start it with focus_start. Work only on its next action. Record progress with checkpoint and close with focus_finish. Capture interruptions instead of switching.

Ask what the user wants more of, what drains them and what they would try for a month. Capture conclusions as notes or candidate experiments. Do not create goals or plans without explicit confirmation.

Plan.description: Choose one to three MITs from real state.

content.text: Call prepare. Propose one to three MITs for the person and day across scopes, using the committed plan, candidates and checkpoints. State why each one matters. Never claim a plan exists before commit_plan succeeds.

Process.description: Decide one inbox item at a time, top to bottom.

content.text: Take the oldest item with inbox_next. Offer exactly one decision: discard, delegate or wait, do it if it takes two minutes, defer with a review date, or turn it into one or more work items. For a knowledge reference, use ztd-knowledge to interpret the lesson and choose a destination from the session's bound scopes (personal); the document's meaning determines the destination, not the capture's source scope. Pass that scope to doc_put. If updating an existing card, use doc_get with the same scope to read its current revision. Write the card first with doc_put as a draft, then call process_capture with outcome reference and the doc_put result's document ID in reason. If doc_put fails, keep the capture pending; if process_capture's response is lost, retry the identical request with the same idempotency key and payload; if it fails, keep the draft and retry the reference later — there is no atomic combined operation. Use process_capture. Do not batch decisions.

Review.description: Review what happened and what is next.

content.text: Review the day or week: completed work, waiting items, inbox state and the next period. Record it with record_review. Source coverage is unavailable until sources are configured; never imply the inbox was fully reviewed.
List due routines, complete only those actually done, and propose adjustments. Routines are not tasks; never mark one complete because it was discussed.

Simplify.description: Remove what does not serve the current goal.

content.text: Identify tasks, projects and sources that no longer serve the active goal. Propose what to cancel, archive or stop. Do not delete or archive without explicit human confirmation.
